en: The image shows a group of men and women, dressed in traditional folk costumes, seated and standing in front of a grand stone building with large arched windows. The women wear long dresses with embroidered aprons, shawls, and headscarves, while the men wear suits, vests, and distinct hats. The image is colorized, likely from an old black-and-white photograph. There is handwritten text along the right edge and printed text at the bottom.
